flash_696691.description: Former North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper has won the US Senate race, delivering a victory for the Democratic Party in the battle for control of the upper chamber of Congress.

flash_696690.description: Democratic Congressman Chris Pappas has won the US Senate race in New Hampshire, defeating former Republican Senator John Sununu.

flash_696688.description: According to the results released so far in the US midterm elections, Democrats currently hold 42 seats in the Senate, compared to 32 seats for Republicans.

flash_696686.description: Trump tells CBS News he is prepared to veto Democratic legislation if Republicans lose Congress, while signaling plans to expand his use of executive powers.

flash_696684.description: Incumbent Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff of Georgia, who is Jewish and aligned with the party's progressive wing, won reelection to the Senate after defeating Republican Congressman Mike Collins, according to Decision Desk HQ.

flash_696682.description: Final polls are now closing in these states: Georgia, Kentucky, South Carolina, Vermont, Virginia, Indiana.

flash_696680.description:
The first polls in the US midterm elections have closed in parts of Kentucky and Indiana, and vote counting is underway.

Polls in additional states are expected to close over the coming hours.

flash_696678.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported a maritime incident approximately 26 kilometers northeast of Lima, Oman.

According to the report, the tanker's company security officer said the vessel was struck by two unidentified projectiles that penetrated the engine room.

No casualties or environmental damage have been reported at this stage.

flash_696676.description:
Opposition leader Yair Lapid sharply criticized Shin Bet Director David Zini over his request to investigate MKs from the Joint List and Ra'am on suspicion of electoral misconduct.

"What we are witnessing tonight is an attempt to crush democracy and steal the election with the help of government plants within the security establishment. This is a direct threat to our democracy from people who refuse to accept defeat. I call on all state institutions to stand firm against this attempt, and on my colleagues in our political camp to put everything else aside and form a government as quickly as possible," Lapid said.

flash_696737.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu assures United Torah Judaism of his commitment to yeshiva students; party remains undecided on whom to recommend for prime minister.

flash_696736.description: After 16 months of development, a device called the Halachic Igniter has been completed. It allows users to generate a spark on a stovetop remotely via wireless control.

flash_696734.description: Hillel Neuer came to challenge a Harvard researcher but found himself confronting the moderator as well. One question about UNRWA exposed an awkward moment.

flash_696732.description: Democratic Rep. Jared Moskowitz wins Florida seat in race between two pro-Israel candidates.

flash_696730.description: Democratic Governor Kathy Hochul expected to defeat Republican Bruce Blakeman in New York, following campaign marked by clashes over antisemitism, Israel, and Jewish voter concerns.

flash_696727.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed declared 'We can turn Inshallah into Alhamdulila.'

flash_696726.description: Israel's Central Elections Committee completes its most extensive election review to date, finding no evidence of irregularities affecting the results.

flash_696724.description: Fallen soldier Uriel Silberman's tefillin miraculously survived the strike on his tank and remained kosher for use, and have gone to help the public in Tel Aviv keep the mitzvah.

flash_696722.description: Biblical and Zionist history show that as much as possible, despite G-d's promise, we did not conquer through strength and with the sword, but in a peaceful manner, paying the best of our money for every piece of the territory of our Land.

flash_696720.description: Instead of focusing on what unites us and on meeting our myriad challenges, the opposition is consumed by their hatred of Netanyahu and their lust for power. That represents a threat to our national security and our future. Opinion.

flash_696718.description: Polls have closed in Alaska and Hawaii

flash_696716.description:
Republican Congressman Mike Lawler, considered one of Israel's most prominent supporters in the US Congress, lost his reelection bid in New York to Democratic candidate Cait Conley.

Lawler conceded defeat after the results of the race became clear.

flash_696715.description:
Melat Kiros, 29, has been elected to the US House of Representatives from Colorado. Kiros, known for her strongly anti-Israel positions, previously claimed that the October 7 terrorist attack was "the inevitable result of Israel's apartheid policies." She also argued that calls for Israel's destruction are not antisemitic and demanded an immediate arms embargo on Israel.

Several other newly elected members of the House are known for their outspoken criticism of Israel: Darializa Avila Chevalier, Claire Valdez, and Brad Lander of New York; Donavan McKinney of Michigan; Chris Rabb of Pennsylvania; and Adam Hamawy of New Jersey. Their victories were consistent with pre-election projections.

flash_696713.description: Democratic candidate Adam Hamilton is projected to win the US Senate race in Kansas, according to CNN. If the projection holds, Hamilton will become the first Democrat elected to the Senate from Kansas in 94 years.

flash_696711.description: Prosecutors authorize assault charges against a University of Michigan student following an attack on Jewish activist Liz Benichou during a campus event.

flash_696709.description: Democratic candidate Gina Hinojosa has won the Texas gubernatorial election, defeating incumbent Republican Governor Greg Abbott.

flash_696772.description: During a visit to the Northern Command, LTG Eyal Zamir warned Hezbollah against rebuilding its terrorist infrastructure and ordered accelerated integration of robotic systems into combat units.

flash_696771.description: US Vice President lists American support for Israel as one of the reasons Republicans lost so many races yesterday.

flash_696769.description: After accusing Gadi Eisenkot of killing his son, bereaved father Yossi Cohen meets him, publicly apologizes and calls for unity and respectful discourse.

flash_696767.description:
The IDF confirmed that earlier on Wednesday, it struck two suspects who were observing IDF soldiers in the area of Qabrikha, outside the Security Zone in southern Lebanon.

The IDF clarified that the strike was conducted to remove the threat against the soldiers operating in the Security Zone.

flash_696765.description: IDF and ISA eliminate Jamal Abu Saeed, Head of Operations in Hamas’ military intelligence apparatus who held Omer Shem Tov in captivity.

flash_696763.description: An X-ray scanner alert temporarily halts entry to President Herzog's residence ahead of coalition consultations, as bomb disposal experts are summoned.

flash_696761.description: An X-ray scanner alert temporarily halts entry to President Herzog's residence ahead of coalition consultations, as bomb disposal experts are summoned.

flash_696759.description:
The President's Residence responded to reports of an unusual security incident during screening procedures, shortly before President Isaac Herzog was scheduled to begin consultations with representatives of the various Knesset factions regarding their recommendations for the next prime minister.

"During a security screening of visitors to the President's Residence, the X-ray scanner triggered an alert, prompting a temporary suspension of entry to the residence pending clarification of the matter. Police bomb disposal experts are on their way to examine the equipment. The incident is being investigated in coordination with the relevant authorities," the President's Residence stated.

flash_696758.description: Shas Council of Torah Sages meeting cancelled shortly before it begins, with reports alleging Deri intervened amid questions over his political future.

flash_696757.description: Prof. Eytan Gilboa believes that Trump's announcement on ending aid to Israel was intended for electoral purposes.

flash_696756.description: Houthis claim attack on King Khaled Airport in Riyadh

flash_696755.description:
A security official confirmed that the IDF struck two suspects in the village of Qabrikha in southern Lebanon, near the Yellow Line, after they approached IDF forces operating in the area and posed a threat to them.

According to the official, the strike was carried out as part of an operation described as "removing a threat."

flash_696753.description: Following a secretive property acquisition operation, Jewish families have moved into eight homes in the Jericho area.

flash_696751.description: According to i24NEWS, Hadash MK Ayman Odeh is suspected of receiving hundreds of thousands of shekels in cash from the Palestinian Authority.

flash_696749.description: Deputy Mayor Yossi Havilio is demanding that municipal benefits be withdrawn from haredim who do not enlist and that the money be redirected to a fund for reservists.

flash_696747.description: The court granted the Chabad Rabbinical Court's request and issued an interim order requiring an immediate halt to all work at Hebron's ancient cemetery.

flash_696745.description: Sarah Huckabee Sanders, daughter of US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee and former Trump White House press secretary, secures reelection as Arkansas governor.

flash_696743.description: Up to 100 mm of rain expected across central Israel on Friday and Saturday, with stormy weather bringing falling temperatures and flooding risks.

flash_696795.description: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries formally announces his bid for speaker following his party's landslide midterm victory, with little opposition expected.

flash_696794.description: Following instructions from leading Lithuanian haredi rabbis, Degel HaTorah will not endorse any candidate for prime minister, while divisions may emerge within United Torah Judaism's Hasidic faction.

flash_696792.description: Feiglin recommends Netanyahu to President Herzog but demands new elections over alleged foreign interference, while setting conditions for joining a coalition.

flash_696790.description: The Prime Minister warned against a coalition dependent on parties he described as "supporters of terrorism" and accused left-wing bloc leaders of setting conditions designed to prevent the formation of a broad government.

flash_696788.description: For those who are not used to keeping Shabbat, even with the right supplies, taking on Shabbat can be a formidable challenge, yet a growing number of Jews in Israel have embraced this foundational mitzvah.

flash_696786.description: The Jewish bond with Hebron began with Avraham's own life there, was strengthened by his purchase of the Cave of Machpelah, and became a source of faith for generations after him.

flash_696784.description: Yisrael Beytenu representative Oded Forer made clear that his party does not rule out cooperation with Likud but refuses to serve in a government alongside the Arab parties.

flash_696782.description:
The Agudat Yisrael faction announced that it will not endorse any candidate for prime minister during its meeting with President Isaac Herzog.

However, two party members, Meir Porush and Elyakim Stark, are considering separately recommending Benjamin Netanyahu to form the next government, but have not yet announced their final decisions.

flash_696781.description:
The Degel Hatorah faction announced that its representatives will not recommend any candidate to President Isaac Herzog to form the next government.

The decision was made at the instruction of the party's rabbinic leaders, Rabbi Dov Lando and Rabbi Moshe Hillel Hirsch.

flash_696779.description: The Yisrael Beytenu faction participated in the round of consultations with President Isaac Herzog. After recommending Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, MK Oded Forer said, "Yisrael Beytenu had hoped for a more decisive election outcome."

flash_696777.description:
Aryeh Deri met on Wednesday evening with Rabbi Moshe Maya, the senior member of the Shas Council of Torah Sages.

It was announced that Deri will resign from the Knesset but will continue to serve as chairman of the party.

Read more.

flash_696775.description: Ra'am to recommend Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government

flash_696773.description:
A heavy concrete structure fell from a construction site in Haifa and struck the dining hall area of a nearby school. No injuries were reported.

Following the incident, the Haifa Municipality ordered construction work at the site to be halted.

flash_696770.description: President's Residence: Police detain foreign journalist after finding explosive residue on her

flash_696768.description: The military censor has authorized publication of information revealing that changes in Hamas's anti-tank forces and the movement of Mohammed Deif and other senior officials into tunnels were detected before the October 7 attack.

flash_696766.description: An employee at the Israeli Tourism Ministry's pavilion was attacked on her way to the World Travel Market international tourism fair in London, a day after she was accosted at the fair.

flash_696805.description: Former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer disputes VP Vance's explanation for Republican midterm losses, arguing the US should have finished the war with Iran.

flash_696804.description: Attorney Michael Rabello, who served as Prime Minister Netanyahu's personal lawyer, has withdrawn his candidacy for State Comptroller following the election results.

flash_696802.description: In leaked recordings, senior Shas spiritual leader Rabbi Moshe Maya backs a Netanyahu-Eisenkot unity government, provided it advances a draft law without enlistment quotas.

flash_696800.description:
One person was killed and two others were injured when a helicopter crashed into the waters of Biscayne Bay near Miami, Florida. The two injured men were taken to a trauma center in serious but stable condition.

According to authorities, the three men aboard the helicopter were filming boats at the time of the crash. The cause of the accident remains under investigation.

flash_696798.description:
Together party chairman Naftali Bennett intends to demand the position of Knesset Speaker, Channel 13 News reported.

According to the report, Bennett wants the position to go either to a member of his party or to another agreed-upon candidate who is not a member of Gadi Eisenkot's party.

flash_696796.description: Lebanon's Hezbollah-affiliated Al Mayadeen network reported a strike in the area between the villages of Markaba and Talloussa in southern Lebanon.

flash_696793.description: According to the report of the French parliamentary commission of inquiry, “political Islam is not a fantasy, not an extrapolation, but a real, documented and visible threat." America, are you listening? Op-ed.

flash_696791.description: Dreaming of a luxury apartment in Jerusalem? Am Yisrael Chai’s Dream Raffle is back and bigger than ever for its ninth year in a row. What’s new about this year’s apartment? And what exactly is the “Super Ticket"? Here’s everything you need to know.

flash_696789.description:
Zehut party chairman Moshe Feiglin asked President Isaac Herzog to consider granting a pardon to Amiram Ben Uliel, who was convicted of murdering three members of the Dawabshe family in the village of Duma.

"In the past, as a member of the Knesset, I worked to secure the release of Roman Zadorov. I ask you to reconsider the issue of granting Amiram Ben Uliel a pardon and securing his release," Feiglin told Herzog.

flash_696787.description: Gadi Eisenkot promises to establish a national emergency government, strengthen bipartisan support for Israel in Washington, and deepen cooperation with President Trump.

flash_696785.description: This is Chuck Schumer’s legacy, a Democratic Party that openly embraces Jew-hate, that defends terrorism and the attempted murder of Jewish children while protecting antisemites at all costs. Opinion.

flash_696783.description:
Asked about Vice President JD Vance's statement attributing the Republican Party's failures in the midterm elections to the Iran war, US President Donald Trump said he believes it is "largely true because it drove the gasoline up."

That being said, he added: "At the same time, if I had to do it again, I'd have to do it again because, long-term, it's the only answer. You can't let Iran have a nuclear weapon. You have no choice"

Read more.

flash_696780.description: The head of the Shin Bet estimated that the suspected foreign interference in the elections involved NIS 100 million, Channel 12 News reported.

flash_696778.description: The critical question this election raises is whether American Jews still have a secure future in the U.S., or if domestic politics will begin to mirror the exceptional, double standards that have long been demanded of the Jewish state globally. Analysis.

flash_696776.description: Following their meeting with President Herzog, Minister Orit Strock and incoming MKs Itamar Eitam and Tzvika Mor discussed the possibility of forming a broad national government.

flash_696830.description: Police review 2,400 hours of footage revealing suspected severe abuse of infants as young as ten months old; three women face imminent indictment.

flash_696829.description: Minister Eliyahu submitted an opinion to the president calling for pardons and reduced sentences for Jewish prisoners convicted of security and nationalist offenses.

flash_696828.description: President Isaac Herzog challenges Democrats during coalition consultations, urging broader political cooperation.

flash_696826.description: Defense attorneys for Netanyahu asked to summon AG Gali Baharav-Miara to court following Avichai Mandelblit's testimony on investigative actions in the case.

flash_696824.description: Growing scam leaves unsuspecting haredi men registered as owners of fictitious businesses, facing massive debts and legal action.

flash_696822.description: Wiener to hold Pelosi’s House seat after race in which both candidates attacked Israel.

flash_696820.description: When Rashi says all her years were for the good, it means every moment of every year.

flash_696818.description: Knowing that today, Israel's operational doctrine is based on neutralizing capabilities, not on proportionality, what will Hezbollah do if Iran is attacked? Opinion.

flash_696816.description: The District Court has dismissed a police appeal against an order requiring police to pay NIS 5,500 to a Samaria resident who was unlawfully arrested, after police representatives failed to show up for the appeal hearing.

flash_696814.description: The Israel Police and Israel Dog Unit, a nonprofit specializing in working dogs, conducted an extensive search operation on Wednesday for Yoram Filter.

flash_696812.description: Podcast: From Israeli earnings to US Social Security and foreign asset reporting, discover the changes that could affect your finances.

flash_696810.description: British police arrest more than two dozen Palestine Action supporters outside the Supreme Court as judges hear a challenge to the group's terrorism designation.

flash_696808.description: Iranian lawmakers dismiss the Democrats' midterm victory, insisting Tehran will not ease its demands.

flash_696806.description: Michigan is a bellwether, a standard-bearer, for much of America. Opinion.

flash_696803.description: Footage from a rally in Tehran shows protesters burning images of Trump, Netanyahu, Vance and Witkoff, a day after a poster threatened to kill the US President.

flash_696801.description: Michigan Democrat Haley Stevens defends her endorsement of Republican Mike Rogers despite his defeat, citing antisemitism concerns and her support for Israel.

flash_696865.description: Shin Bet chief David Zini compared the alleged influx of foreign money during the elections to the October 7 failure at a closed-door conference.

flash_696864.description: Iran's security chief delivers Khamenei's message to Putin and discusses regional security, ending the war and a possible gas pipeline from Russia to Iran.

flash_696862.description: Palestinian Arab sources told i24NEWS that Palestinian Authority Chairman Mahmoud Abbas had instructed that donations be provided to support Joint List MK Ayman Odeh's public and political activities.

flash_696860.description:
Yisrael Beytenu chairman Avigdor Liberman is dropping his veto on the haredi parties, according to a report by Channel 12 News.

Meanwhile, the opposition bloc is working to form a government in cooperation with United Torah Judaism, based on a lenient haredi conscription law.

flash_696858.description:
Iranian Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezai met on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin. During the meeting, Rezai handed the Russian President a personal letter from Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

According to the Iranian official, he discussed with Putin the creation of a gas pipeline from Iran to Russia.

flash_696856.description: Bennett and Lapid's Together party recommends Eisenkot to form the next government, rejects haredi draft exemptions and warns against political unity.

flash_696854.description: Argentine President Javier Milei and Yisrael Ganz, Governor of the Binyamin Regional Council and Chairman of the Yesha Council, held an extended meeting.

flash_696852.description:
During the consultations at the President's Residence, Ram Ben Barak, a representative of the Together party, said that the President opposes political boycotts.

Herzog replied: "Absolutely. I think ruling people out politically is one of the biggest mistakes we have made as a nation." He added that such exclusions deepen divisions within Israeli society and "only tear the nation apart."

flash_696851.description: Herzog asks whether the Joint List would withdraw support during a war with Iran or Hamas, but party chairman Jabareen declines to give a firm commitment.

flash_696849.description: A Kantar Institute poll, conducted exclusively among the Jewish public, indicates widespread opposition to the establishment of a government led by the Change Bloc with the support of Ra'am and United Torah Judaism.

flash_696847.description:
MK Ahmad Tibi told President Isaac Herzog that the Joint List would provide a parliamentary safety net for the government, despite their differences.

"Our recommendation that Eisenkot be tasked with forming a government is not out of any affection for him," Tibi said. "We are not choosing between good and less good, but between bad and the lesser of two evils."

flash_696846.description:
Prof. Yousef Jabareen, chairman of the Joint List, accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Itamar Ben Gvir of engaging in ongoing incitement during his faction's consultations with President Isaac Herzog. According to Jabareen, similar statements directed at Jews in a European country would be considered antisemitic, and rightly so.

Jabareen also referred to the Prime Minister's son, claiming that he had written that Arab citizens would carry out "the next October 7."

Addressing the President, Jabareen said: "These are statements that cannot simply be ignored. We expected greater involvement from you as President of the State of Israel."

flash_696845.description: An IDF reservist who posed as a licensed physician and performed unauthorized procedures on soldiers in Gaza is sentenced to 30 months in prison.

flash_696844.description: Shas chairman Aryeh Deri addressed the election results at a faction meeting, declaring, "300,000 votes is not a collapse," and promising to learn lessons from the defeat.

flash_696842.description: The Arab Joint List unanimously backs Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, despite criticizing his camp's response to incitement against Arab citizens.

flash_696839.description: At least 25 flights across Europe face bomb threats, prompting diversions, evacuations and fighter jet escorts as authorities investigate their origin.

flash_696837.description:
Between his consultation meetings with representatives of the various Knesset factions, President Isaac Herzog met on Thursday with former British Prime Minister Tony Blair.

Blair currently serves on the Board of Peace and last year developed a plan for Gaza's postwar administration.

flash_696881.description: After United Torah Judaism declined to endorse Netanyahu, MK Yitzhak Pindrus makes clear that the party has not abandoned its partnership with Israel's religious community.

flash_696880.description:
Bereaved mother Lali Deri criticized the change bloc over reports of talks to form a government with the haredi parties.

Deri recalled Avigdor Liberman's campaign slogan, "100% for soldiers, 0% for draft evaders," and wrote that if the report was accurate, it would amount to "a slap in the face not only to our soldiers, but also to the overwhelming majority of voters who supported the bloc of those who serve."

"Your hatred, hostility, and distrust of Benjamin Netanyahu have driven you out of your minds," she added. "I still can't believe the report is true. Because if it is, this is one of the most cynical moments we have ever experienced."

flash_696878.description: Romanian intelligence services reported that two additional aircraft had received bomb threats, including a KLM flight to Tel Aviv that stopped in Bucharest.

flash_696876.description: President Trump warns that US forces are ready to resume strikes on Iran if necessary, while insisting Tehran cannot act without Washington's approval.

flash_696874.description: Review of Ahmed Fouad Alkhatib’s book, Hamas and Its Two Million Hostages

flash_696872.description:
President Isaac Herzog announced at the conclusion of the consultations that 67 MKs had recommended Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, compared to 46 who recommended Benjamin Netanyahu.

Herzog clarified that despite the results, it remains unclear whether a government can be formed due to the parties' mutual refusals to cooperate with one another.

He said he would hold personal talks with some party leaders before assigning the mandate on Sunday. "I intend to leave no stone unturned in an effort to encourage the parties to reach out to one another and build a stable and effective government for the people of Israel."

flash_696871.description:
The Yashar party responded to the 67 Knesset members who recommended Gadi Eisenkot to form the next government, calling on President Isaac Herzog to give him the mandate as soon as possible. The party claimed that this was the highest number of recommendations received by a candidate since 2015.

"Benjamin Netanyahu is a caretaker prime minister with the support of a minority of just 46 Knesset members," the party stated.

Yashar called for the formation of a national emergency government and warned that missing the opportunity could lead to another round of elections.

flash_696869.description: As Yashar recommends Eisenkot, Herzog expresses concern over American defense aid and urges swift government formation, while Yashar rejects Netanyahu unity.

flash_696867.description:
A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Tehran had submitted a proposal on the nuclear issue to the United States through Qatar and that Washington was reviewing it.

According to the official, discussions on the proposal could take place only after the United States agrees to Iran's demands.

flash_696863.description: After years of opposition, MK Avigdor Liberman has lifted his veto on the haredi parties and authorized negotiations to form a government with Shas and United Torah Judaism.

flash_696861.description: Iran is reviewing new nuclear proposals advanced by Qatari mediators, as Washington and Tehran weigh renewed diplomacy amid threats of further military action.

flash_696859.description:
Jerusalem Police Special Patrol Unit (YASAM) officers arrested a 17-year-old from Ein Naqquba on suspicion of throwing rocks at vehicles near the entrance to Jerusalem.

During a search of the suspect, officers found additional rocks believed to have been intended for throwing. Police are continuing to search for another suspect who fled the scene.

flash_696857.description:
President Isaac Herzog expressed concern over the issue of US aid to Israel, saying the announcement that it was being stopped had come as "a bolt from the blue."

Herzog noted that the US-Israel Memorandum of Understanding on military assistance is set to remain in effect until 2028, and stressed the need to form a government and avoid another round of elections.

flash_696855.description: Representatives of the Shin Bet, Israel Police, and the State Attorney's Office held a meeting today amid suspicions of foreign interference in the elections.

flash_696853.description: Israel, Greece and Cyprus agree to deepen defense cooperation, strengthen maritime security and reject the Turkey-Libya maritime agreement.

flash_696896.description: An Agudat Yisrael representative on the Central Elections Committee made clear that the party is open to negotiations with Gadi Eisenkot, provided an agreed-upon legislative solution to the issue of haredi military conscription is presented.

flash_696895.description: Our children are being abused in the UK because they are Jews. A child’s right to feel safe at school is a concrete obligation. It should carry more weight than an adult activist’s determination to preserve their preferred vocabulary. Opinion.

flash_696893.description: Are we going to be disheartened by a viciously anti-Israel political swing on our most important human ally? Or do we maintain our faith and trust G-d to continue guiding human history? G-d's tests of Abraham help us see the light.

flash_696891.description: Secrets of Moshiach and the circuitous route of redemption.

flash_696889.description: Pete Hegseth rejects impeachment efforts as political theater after Republican midterm losses, while Trump praises his performance amid calls for his removal.

flash_696887.description: Israeli Ambassador to the UN says Hamas extorts $3,000 from Gaza merchants for each aid truck, generating $2 million daily, and insists Hamas must leave Gaza.

flash_696885.description: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeats Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass, prompting Jewish organizations to demand action against antisemitism amid concerns over Israel.

flash_696883.description: A Montreal kosher bakery suffers extensive damage in a suspected arson attack, prompting a hate crimes investigation after a second incident in two days.

flash_696879.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio rejects reports he may resign after Republicans' midterm defeat, declines to discuss 2028 and defends Trump's leadership

flash_696877.description: President Herzog announces that he will assign the mandate to form a government on Sunday, cautions that Eisenkot's ability to build a coalition remains uncertain despite securing 67 recommendations.

flash_696875.description: Arab rioters torch a Jewish family's car in Gefen Ami, while Beit Ummar villagers report a separate attack by Jewish rioters.

flash_696873.description: Likud recommended Netanyahu to form the next government. Herzog criticized the attacks on Eisenkot and asked whether the party was prepared to give up its extremists.

flash_696870.description:
Jerusalem District police officers, along with Special Patrol Unit (YASAM) and Border Police forces, are working to disperse a haredi protest against the light rail on Bar-Ilan Street in Jerusalem.

According to police, protesters blocked roads and threw objects and rocks. After the demonstration was declared illegal and protesters ignored orders to disperse, security forces began clearing the area.

flash_696868.description: Momentum in America is with the red-green alliance because centrists lack a moral and intellectual spine. A great evil has arisen in the world, and it’s now captured the political heart of America. Opinion.

flash_696916.description: Border Police arrest seven illegal infiltrators near Jerusalem, including a driver who allegedly wore Haredi clothing and grew payot to evade checks.

flash_696915.description: Marking the third anniversary of Moshe Yedidyah's death, his father called for unity and shared an emotional prayer for his brother Neriyah, who arrived at the hospital without a pulse after being wounded in a terrorist attack.

flash_696913.description: Thousands of Jews arrive in Hebron for Shabbat Chayei Sarah, as hundreds of police officers deploy to secure the annual pilgrimage to the holy city.

flash_696911.description: Avraham Aviinu and Sarah Imeynu continue to show us the way to deal with life's challenges without giving up.

flash_696909.description:
Otzma Yehudit chairman Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir criticized left-wing leaders over their contacts with the haredi parties, accusing them of deceiving their voters and undermining military reservists.

According to Ben-Gvir, after running a campaign focused on drafting haredim into the military, left-wing leaders are now rushing to cooperate with the haredi parties. "Those who insult the intelligence of their voters are the leaders of the liberal, enlightened, and educated public," he said.

Ben-Gvir claimed that the left is acting contrary to the values it presents to the public, adding: "The alliance of those who serve is an agreement to exempt people from military service. There are no left-wing values. Everything is a lie for campaign purposes," he said. Concluding his remarks, Ben-Gvir referred to the weekly Torah portion of Chayei Sarah, emphasized the Jewish people's connection to the Cave of the Patriarchs and the Land of Israel, and called on the public to visit Hebron.

flash_696908.description: Yisrael Beytenu's Dan Illouz rejects Liberman's proposed haredi draft compromise, pledges to fight exemption legislation, and urges Zionist unity.

flash_696906.description: Keep the popcorn handy. This might just be the greatest political show on earth, Op-ed

flash_696904.description: Thousands of items have been collected within days of the launch of the military equipment return operation. Lt. Col. N. of the Home Front Command explains why the IDF decided to allow anonymous returns without prosecution.

flash_696902.description: Canadian intelligence agencies and the federal police report a pace of radicalization not seen since the September 11 attacks.

flash_696900.description: Eva Geller died after months of hospital treatment following the mass shooting at a Hanukkah celebration in Sydney.

flash_696898.description: Following an Arutz Sheva report, the IDF has decided to stop providing PA security forces with advance notice of arrest operations amid concerns that the information could be leaked to terrorists.

flash_696894.description: Former Labor MK Colette Avital claimed that Yasser Arafat was no longer a terrorist toward the end of his life and made an outrageous comparison between him and Menachem Begin.

flash_696892.description: Trump has done Israel a favor. Most of the money Americans supposedly “give" Israel is money Israel must spend in America, and it gives the US leverage over Israeli decision-making. Israel’s relationship with the United States will now reflect its own priorities. Opinion.

flash_696890.description: CAIR halts operations in Florida after a federal judge declines to block its terrorist designation.

flash_696888.description: Iran submits a nuclear proposal to Washington through Qatar but insists the US meet seven demands before negotiations, as Trump warns of possible new strikes.

flash_696922.description:
Iran is distributing iodine tablets near nuclear sites amid concerns over renewed US strikes.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_696921.description:
Ofer Winter takes responsibility for his party's failure, rejects claims his voters cost the right, and urges Bennett and Liberman to end their boycott of Netanyahu and form a Zionist government.

flash_696914.description:
The United States and Iran are approaching a possible breakthrough in negotiations to end the war, Bloomberg reported.

According to the report, Tehran is signaling a willingness to discuss issues related to its nuclear program that it had previously refused to address during the talks.

The potential shift in Iran's position could pave the way for an agreement between the two sides. However, the report noted that significant disagreements remain between Washington and Tehran.
